title: The reward has an admin bill
hook: A toy reward scheme requires logging before every completed block; compare its time cost.

knows: basic arithmetic and how to compare two stated rules
doesNotKnow: how to account for monitoring overhead separately from claims about intrinsic motivation

misconception: The incentive’s stated reward captures all costs of the scheme that administers it.
objective: Account for monitoring overhead separately from claims about intrinsic motivation.

claims.text: Original stipulated toy: All logging mandatory; tasks and logging cannot overlap; no effect of rewards on effort, persistence or quality is included. Brief logging permits {A}; detailed logging {B}. Monitoring consumes time even before any motivational response is considered.
